title: Task - PII / Safety
justification: Reviewed all task materials: prompt, gameplay_config.txt, bomb_runtime_log.txt, scene_reference.png, source_coin_token.png, bomb_blast_frame.png, Bomb.glb, Bomb_Chain_Reaction_Godot_Project.zip contents, and bundle.json metadata. No real names paired with sensitive data, no contact information, no financial information, no sensitive personal details. The prompt uses generic role references ('our 3D artist', 'our art director', 'our designer') without any actual names. The runtime log contains a device model identifier ('Apple A18 Pro') which is hardware info, not personal data. The ZIP archive paths use a project folder name ('Bomb_Chain_Reaction_Working') with no personal directory references. All content is purely technical game development material.
evidence: Prompt references: 'our 3D artist', 'our art director', 'our designer' (generic roles, no names). Runtime log header: 'OpenGL API 4.1 Metal - 90.5 - Compatibility - Using Device: Apple - Apple A18 Pro' (device model, not personal info).
